description: A concentrated coffee beverage brewed by forcing hot water under high pressure through finely ground coffee beans, forming a rich, dark crema on top.
name: Espresso
steps: Grind 7-9 grams of fresh coffee beans very finely (like powdered sugar).
Tamp the grounds evenly and firmly into the portafilter.
Insert the portafilter into the espresso machine's group head.
Start the shot, aiming for 25-30 seconds to extract 1-2 ounces (30-60ml) of liquid.
Serve immediately in a demitasse cup.

description: A popular coffee drink made with espresso and a generous amount of steamed milk, topped with a thin layer of microfoam. Known for its creamy texture.
name: Latte
steps: Prepare one or two shots of espresso into a mug.
Steam 6-8 ounces (180-240ml) of cold milk until it reaches 140-150°F (60-65°C), creating smooth microfoam.
Gently swirl the steamed milk to integrate the foam.
Pour the steamed milk into the espresso, initially tilting the cup to combine, then straightening to create latte art if desired.
Serve warm.

description: An espresso-based coffee drink with equal parts espresso, steamed milk, and foamed milk. It has a distinct layered appearance and a stronger coffee taste than a latte.
name: Cappuccino
steps: Prepare one or two shots of espresso into a cappuccino cup.
Steam 5-6 ounces (150-180ml) of cold milk until it reaches 140-150°F (60-65°C), creating more foam than for a latte.
Gently swirl the steamed milk and tap the pitcher to remove large bubbles.
Pour the steamed milk into the espresso, aiming for a roughly equal ratio of espresso, liquid milk, and foam on top.
Serve immediately.

description: A coffee drink prepared by diluting an espresso with hot water, giving it a similar strength to, but different flavor from, brewed coffee. It's lighter than a traditional espresso.
name: Americano
steps: Heat water to near boiling (around 200°F / 93°C).
Prepare one or two shots of espresso into a mug.
Pour 4-6 ounces (120-180ml) of hot water into the mug, on top of the espresso.
Serve hot, optionally with milk or sugar.

description: An espresso 'marked' or 'stained' with a small amount of foamed milk. It's a stronger coffee flavor than a cappuccino or latte, highlighting the espresso.
name: Macchiato
steps: Prepare a single or double shot of espresso into a demitasse cup.
Steam a small amount of milk (about 2 ounces / 60ml) to create a thick, airy foam.
Spoon a dollop of the foamed milk directly onto the center of the espresso.
Serve immediately.

description: A chocolate-flavored variant of a latte, made with espresso, steamed milk, and chocolate syrup or powder.
name: Mocha
steps: Add 1-2 tablespoons of chocolate syrup (or cocoa powder) to the bottom of a mug.
Prepare one or two shots of espresso directly into the mug, mixing with the chocolate.
Steam 6-8 ounces (180-240ml) of cold milk until it reaches 140-150°F (60-65°C), creating smooth microfoam.
Pour the steamed milk into the chocolate-espresso mixture.
Optionally top with whipped cream, chocolate shavings, or a drizzle of chocolate syrup.
